provenance.what: the SAME probe run against a runtime frozen before it had ever reported a count: `degraded` never fires and `subagents_running` is `null` from the first sample
provenance.how: isolated `lop mobile serve` at that ref; SIGSTOPped ~5 s after the prompt was admitted
provenance.redactions: no home path or personal detail in the sample; the session id is throwaway

note: A record whose beat was never stamped reads as FRESH — a record's beat defaults to now — so the scan never classifies it wedged and neither receipt appears, while the counts are already `null` because there is no beat to vouch for. This is the caveat the degraded-row capture names: the receipt needs a runtime that reported at least once. A client must not read `degraded: false` plus `subagents_running: null` as healthy.
